notes.title: New Language: GERMAN
notes.content:
[h1] New Language: GERMAN[/h1]

Hello everyone,

We are proud to announce the addition of a new language to our game: German!

The game now features 10 different board sizes, each with 50 unique sections. Every section contains 50 levels of increasing difficulty. This adds up to a total of 25,000 completely distinct levels to enjoy.

Now you can play the game in a new language whenever you need to refresh your mind.

[h2] Other Updates [/h2]
[olist]
[*] Minor improvements
[/olist]

notes.title: Update Notes For July 22
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This update includes new features, improvements, and bug fixes listed below:

[b]New Feature:[/b] Time Toggle
[list]
[*] The time panel can now be toggled and hidden for players who don't want to be bothered by a ticking clock.
[/list]
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Language panel texts update immediately after selecting a flag. No need to press the Apply button anymore.
[*] Fonts have been updated, and errors related to several special characters have been fixed.
[*] The game settings panel now properly displays the current resolution in the combo box as selected.
[/list]

notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Achievements were one of the most important features we were working on for a while. In this version, you will be able to unlock 60+ achievements. We hope you will like them. We are still working on new achievement ideas.

We have added a time counter to the levels. There is no time limit to complete the level. It just records the time in case you want to complete it with a better record.

The full release date is getting closer. We have mostly focused on bug fixes, stability, and performance issues.

See you in the next update.

Here is the detailed explanation about the content of this update:

[b]Achievements:[/b]
There are 60+ achievements in Super Words in this version. 20+ of them are secret.

[b]Time:[/b]
A time counter is added to the game. It does not affect gameplay but provides a goal to replay the level.

[b]Completion Info:[/b]
The main menu now shows the completion ratios for each size and section. It is also possible to see the best completion time for a level.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] A settings panel has been added to the game screen.
[*] Music volume now has a separate slider for adjustment.
[*] Minor visual and performance improvements.
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: The Biggest Update of Early Access
notes.content:
Hello friends,

Welcome to the biggest update of Super Words since the beginning of the early access period.

Here are some major highlights of this update:

[h3]Mid-Level Save:[/h3]

The game now autosaves after every move on the board. If you return to the home screen or close the game, you can continue playing the same level later. A warning pop-up has been added for players who want to reset the level and start a new one.

[h3]20,000 New Levels for Each Language:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307011/f3f88379789002cc5c5952700f75d27c8dd698c8.jpg[/img]
The first version had 5,000 levels for each language. We have added 20,000 new levels, bringing the total to 25,000 for each language. This totals 125,000 levels across the five supported languages.

[h3]Colored Theme:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307011/9ed57713211237ab29270fea52259899656d6b0f.jpg[/img]
The green-themed main design was cool, but with such a large amount of content, seeing the same colors all the time could become monotonous. Therefore, we have implemented a dynamic colored theme system that changes with the board size, section, and level parameters.

[h3]Hotkeys:[/h3]

The first version relied solely on the mouse. We have now added hotkeys for more interaction on the board:

[list]
[*] [b]Space:[/b] Rotates the selected word. If no word is selected, it does nothing.
[*] [b]Backspace:[/b] Resets the board and places all words in the Reserved Area.
[*] [b]Esc:[/b] Returns to the Main Menu.
[/list]
